title: Sissirat's Amazing Relic
description: Sissirat's Amazing Relic — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 1 of Sissirat's Amazing Cheery Cup of Jo Relics from within Algernon and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 20 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 1 of Sissirat's Amazing Cheery Cup of Jo Relics from within Algernon and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Private Buyer Looking for an Amazing Relic!
WANTED: 1 of Sissirat's Amazing Cheery Cup of Jo Relics. Looking for that last touch to really bring my cubicle to life. Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Sissirat's Amazing Relic ×1

Level range: 1–25
